name: weighted dumbbell crunch (hands overhead) v. 2
description: A second version of the overhead dumbbell crunch. It builds ab strength with a loaded reach.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell at one end with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Crunch up and let the dumbbell travel in an arc toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
